generations.prompt: Night in a moonlit Italian Renaissance courtyard, the camera locked off at courtyard level looking up at a stone balcony; vertical frame. The young man in the wine-red velvet doublet stands on the flagstones below, looking up at the balcony, his right hand on his heart, his left hand holding a softly glowing phone at his chest. The young woman in the pale gold gown stands at the balustrade above, her hands on the rail, looking down at him. He speaks up to her, slowly and with great feeling, exactly these words: "O lady of the lattice, the moon is only practising to be your face." She listens, and lifts a hand to her ear. The camera does not move. Exactly two people; nobody else appears. Sound: his voice clearly, crickets, a small fountain trickling, a light breeze in the jasmine; no music. No on-screen text, no captions, no lettering anywhere.
